name: digestif-node
description: The node's local API: what the web UI on localhost reads and writes. The node serves the static UI and this API from one origin bound to 127.0.0.1. It opens the UI through a one-time launch URL that sets an HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict session cookie, and refuses any request without that cookie and a Digestif-Local: 1 header. The custom header forces a CORS preflight, which the node never answers, so a page on another origin can neither read nor post. Later the relay serves the same UI as the phone web app against the same operations. Nothing here is wire format: the relay contract is spec/digestif-relay.json and docs/protocol.md.

note_version.description: One version of a note: the agent's, or the member's edit. A version reaches nobody, the member included, until both checks pass, except that a member sees their own edit's result.

fields.name: number
fields.description: 1 for the agent's version (1 and 2 for a pair), then one per edit.

fields.name: voice
fields.description: agent for the agent's version, person for the member's edit.

fields.name: text
fields.description: Present once both checks have passed, or for the member's own edit once its checks finish.

fields.name: removed
fields.description: Whether the checks removed anything from this version.

note_progress.description: A note the run has not handed over: the first note from the setup chat starting it, which the note page shows until its first version arrives.

fields.name: step
fields.description: While writing, once the run has reached a step.

fields.name: sources
fields.description: While writing: the labels of the sources read so far.

fields.name: message
fields.description: While failed: why.

note_summary.description: A row of Notes. Status notes are not listed: there is nothing to approve.

fields.name: shared_at
fields.description: When the send reached the circle; absent until it does.

fields.name: preview
fields.description: The note's first line, at most 140 characters; absent while its first version is unchecked.

notes.description: Notes: every note the run has handed over, newest first.

fields.name: suggest_auto_approval
fields.description: True after five notes in a row approved with no change, until an edited note, Not now, or turning the setting off restarts the count. Saves nothing.

fields.name: no_activity
fields.description: True while the first note has not been handed over and the last note time found nothing: there is no empty note.

search_excerpt.description: The passage of a hit's text where the words matched, on one line, at most 160 characters with an ellipsis where it was cut; it reads from the start when no word matches the start of a word as written.

fields.name: ref
fields.description: The hit it is of: an Inbox item's id, a feed message's hash or a note's id.

search_results.description: One search over the full text the node holds, each kind at most limit hits, best first. Every hit is a row its own list shows: the member's Inbox, the feed's believed messages beside the member's own refused and unsent ones, notes by the version the Notes list previews, and the circle's current members.

fields.name: inbox
fields.description: Inbox items whose title or detail holds every word.

fields.name: feed
fields.description: Feed messages whose full text holds every word.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: The member's notes whose shown version holds every word.

fields.name: members
fields.description: Members whose name or agent name holds every word.

fields.name: excerpts
fields.description: Where each Inbox, feed and note hit matched, one for each hit that holds text.

note.description: A note page. It keeps the version the member is reading and says when an edit made a newer one; there is no list of versions.

fields.name: version
fields.description: The version asked for, else the newest whose checks passed; absent while progress is present.

fields.name: newer_version_id
fields.description: Present when an edit made a version newer than the one shown.

fields.name: progress
fields.description: Present while the note has no version: the first note before the run hands it over.

fields.name: pair
fields.description: A note written in two versions for a suggestion this member judges, while it waits and no edit has been made: both versions, in the order the node drew at random, neither saying which prompt wrote it. Approving either, or an edit of either, is the pick.

fields.name: can_approve
fields.description: Waiting, and version's checks passed. While a newer version's checks run or cannot finish there is nothing to approve. A pair's two versions are both approvable.

fields.name: can_edit
fields.description: Waiting with a version. A shared note reads only.

fields.name: not_sent
fields.description: Why the check at signing refused the version, in the page's words: Not sent. A deny list entry matches Worked on. Edit it.

note_edit_form.description: Edit's Save or Save & approve: a new version, which both checks run on like any other.

fields.name: edited_version_id
fields.description: The version the member was reading when they edited.

fields.name: approve
fields.description: Save & approve: the version goes out only if the checks remove nothing; otherwise it stays Waiting and the member sees the result.

note_approve_form.description: Approve the version on the page, exactly that text.

log_removal.description: What one check run removed, by part of the note, by what it broke and by the passages it removed. The passages are kept on the member's own node and shown to the member alone: never signed, never sent to the relay, never read by another node.

fields.name: part
fields.description: The heading of the part of the note; a removal that emptied a part dropped it, heading included.

fields.name: detector
fields.description: With cause detector: the type, such as an API key. A secret is named only by its type.

fields.name: passages
fields.description: The text removed, one entry per passage, each widened to its sentence or list item. Absent with cause detector: a secret is named only by its type.

learnings.description: One text the agent keeps from the member's edits of notes, which the member can also edit. What the member wrote stands.

note_time.description: When the work run writes a note: any time of day in the member's time zone.

fields.name: time
fields.description: HH:MM.

fields.name: time_zone
fields.description: An IANA time zone, such as America/New_York.

fields.name: time
fields.description: HH:MM.

digest_settings.description: Where and when the daily digest is mailed. Until an email is set, no digest is written.

fields.name: email
fields.description: The address the digest is mailed to. Absent until the member sets one.

fields.name: hour
fields.description: The local hour, 0 to 23, after which the day's digest is written.

names.description: The member's name and their agent's, from their signed card. Absent before a card is published; member_name then falls back to the name their invite gave them.

fields.name: published
fields.description: Whether this member has a signed card. Until one is published every other member reads them by the name their invite gave them.

names_form.description: A new card: both names, signed and appended on the next sync, as `digestif card` writes it.

agent.description: The coding agent the node runs: the setup chat's, and the note writer's harness when it is Claude Code.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Claude Code, Codex, or the program's file name.

fields.name: path
fields.description: Absolute.

agent_form.description: Change the agent: saved only once it passes the agent check setup runs (it answers a one-line prompt and runs digestif setup check).

fields.name: path
fields.description: A path, ~ expanded, or a program name looked up on PATH.

agent_check.description: The agent check Save started, the newest since the node started: the program it checks and where it stands. The program is saved as the agent only when it passes.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Claude Code, Codex, or the program's file name.

fields.name: path
fields.description: Absolute.

fields.name: message
fields.description: Why it failed, ending Not saved; only when failed.

problem.description: One open or closed problem: a job's failure, whatever the job. The same job and kind add to one open problem, and the job's next success closes it.

fields.name: source
fields.description: With kind source_failed: the source's label.

fields.name: detail
fields.description: Where or why the job failed, as its latest report said: with kind source_failed, the file the source ran past its share of the deadline in; with job self_update, the state of the node's updates in the member's words.

fields.name: retry_version
fields.description: With job self_update while it is open: the release a Try again takes another try at, when that can help (the refusal may have been this machine, or a stage waits out its backoff).

organization.description: The organization of a remote, or a repository with no remote as its own group.

repository.description: One remote, every clone of it counted once.

fields.name: found_at
fields.description: When the scan first found it.

fields.name: found_by
fields.description: How it turned up; absent for a repository setup found.

fields.name: clone_count
fields.description: How many clones of it the machine holds.

fields.name: path
fields.description: Where one of its clones is, with ~ for the home directory; clone_count says how many there are. Absent when the machine holds no clone of it. The node's own API serves it and nothing carries it off the machine.

fields.name: last_own_commit_at
fields.description: The newest commit by one of the member's commit authors in any clone, read by code from the clone's log, author and date only.

repository_form.description: Unchecking a repository under All declines it and keeps the choice.

repository_status_count.description: How many repositories hold one status.

commit_author.description: A git identity whose default-branch commits enter the record.

fields.name: member_set
fields.description: The member added or relabelled it: a later scan never removes or relabels it.

suggestion_pick.description: One judge's pick in a round: the note they approved and which version it was.

fields.name: at
fields.description: When the note they approved was signed.

suggestion_round.description: A round: each judge's next pick, in order. A round is decided once every judge has picked in it.

fields.name: number
fields.description: 1 for the first night's picks, then one per night the pair ran again.

fields.name: result
fields.description: Absent while a judge has not picked.

suggestion_summary.description: A row of the suggestions list.

fields.name: hash
fields.description: The suggestion's envelope hash, sha256:<hex>.

fields.name: change
fields.description: One line saying what the suggestion changes.

fields.name: judge
fields.description: This member is one of its judges.

fields.name: running
fields.description: This member's notes are written in two versions with it now: they judge it, and it is the oldest undecided suggestion they judge.

suggestion.description: A suggested change to the nightly note prompt: the whole suggested prompt, its judges and every round so far.

fields.name: text
fields.description: The whole suggested prompt.

fields.name: prompt_id
fields.description: sha256:<hex> of the text: the id a note written with it carries.

fields.name: judges
fields.description: The author first, then the members they named.

fields.name: decided_at
fields.description: When the round that adopted or closed it was complete.

fields.name: live
fields.description: It is the circle's live prompt now.

fields.name: can_withdraw
fields.description: This member wrote it and it is still judging.

fields.name: pull_request_owed
fields.description: Adopted, written by this member, and no pull request recorded yet: the nightly behavior opens one proposing it as the release's default.

fields.name: pull_request_url
fields.description: The pull request this member's node opened for it.

suggestion_form.description: Suggest a change to the nightly note prompt. The author is always a judge.

fields.name: text
fields.description: The whole suggested prompt. It must include {{always_on_rules}}.

fields.name: change
fields.description: One line saying what it changes.

fields.name: judges
fields.description: Other members' identities who judge it beside the author.

pull_request_form.description: The pull request the nightly behavior opened for an adopted suggestion.

note_prompt.description: The circle's live nightly note prompt, which every member's note is written with, and the suggestion this member's notes judge now.

fields.name: text
fields.description: The circle's live prompt; absent while no suggestion has been adopted and the release's own behaviors/prompts/nightly-note.md stands.

fields.name: id
fields.description: sha256:<hex> of text, when text is present.

fields.name: adoption
fields.description: Present with text.

fields.name: running
fields.description: The suggestion this member's next note is written in two versions with.

prompt_adoption.description: Where the circle's live prompt came from: the prompt envelope that adopted it.

fields.name: suggestion
fields.description: The adopted suggestion's hash.

fields.name: author
fields.description: Who suggested it.

fields.name: at
fields.description: When it was adopted.

item_to.description: Whom an item is addressed to: the circle, or the members it names. An item to the member alone names only them.

fields.name: circle
fields.description: Addressed to the circle: signed plaintext every member reads.

fields.name: members
fields.description: The members it names, sealed to them and the author; empty on a circle item.

item_words.description: An agent's words of a draft its member edited, kept beside what was sent. They never leave the author's node.

item_answer.description: One answer to a question, or one reply to a notice or a choice.

fields.name: hash
fields.description: The answer's envelope hash: what a close names.

item_pick.description: One reader's pick on a choice. This node reads the member's own picks and every pick on a choice the member wrote.

item_close.description: One close or reopen by the item's author or their agent.

fields.name: closed
fields.description: False when this reopened the item.

fields.name: answer
fields.description: The hash of the answer that unblocked a question.

fields.name: voice
fields.description: agent when the asker's agent closed it, person when the author did; a person's stands over an agent's.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The node's id for the item: a draft has one before it has an envelope.

fields.name: deadline_at
fields.description: A choice's deadline, when its default takes effect.

fields.name: about
fields.description: The hash of the message it came from, as on item. Items about the same message are one thread in the Inbox.

fields.name: link
fields.description: Where a work notice's idea was filed, or was already filed: a URL, an owner/repo#n or a tracker key. Shown as a link on its row. Absent on every other subject and on work that was not filed.

fields.name: done
fields.description: Why it is settled for the member.

fields.name: archived_at
fields.description: When the member archived it out of their Inbox. New activity clears it.

fields.name: reviewed_at
fields.description: When the member's agent's reading run read it. Absent on the node's own items, the member's own, and one no run has read.

invite_email.description: An invite email to send from the member's own address (docs/protocol.md, Approvals): its To, its subject, its text and the mailto: link that opens it in the member's mail app.

fields.name: to
fields.description: The guest, as Name <address>.

fields.name: text
fields.description: The email as the admins signed it, its install command and expiry filled in.

fields.name: mailto
fields.description: A mailto: link carrying the To, the subject and the text.

item.description: One question, choice or notice (docs/protocol.md, Items).

fields.name: id
fields.description: The node's id for the item: a draft has one before it has an envelope.

fields.name: approval
fields.description: On an approval item: the approval, its signatures and, on a promotion, the member's release key.

fields.name: deadline_at
fields.description: A choice's deadline, when its default takes effect.

fields.name: reviewed_at
fields.description: When the member's agent's reading run read it. Absent on the node's own items, the member's own, and one no run has read.

fields.name: hash
fields.description: The envelope hash, once sent. Absent on a draft and on a local item.

fields.name: local
fields.description: Derived from the subject: a local item is shown only on this machine, never sent, mailed or shown on a phone.

fields.name: done
fields.description: Why it is settled for the member.

fields.name: about
fields.description: The hash of the message it came from: the note whose Questions part asked it, or the message a work notice was written from.

fields.name: archived_at
fields.description: When the member archived it out of their Inbox. New activity clears it.

fields.name: source
fields.description: The paragraph of the message it came from holding the words that produced it, when the run that wrote it recorded them and this node holds that message with those words in it. Absent otherwise; the page then links to the message alone (ISS-85463).

fields.name: adopted
fields.description: A credit's: how the idea was adopted, as_work for a credit that carries none. Absent on every other subject.

fields.name: link
fields.description: Where the idea of a work notice or a credit was filed, or was already filed: a URL, an owner/repo#n or a tracker key. Absent on every other subject and on work that could not be filed.

fields.name: path
fields.description: Where on this node the member acts on a node's own item, such as the waiting note's page.

fields.name: address
fields.description: The address to type on the node's machine to reach path: the node's own URL, port included, then path. Present with path on the member's own node notice.

fields.name: invite_email
fields.description: On the member's own send_invite notice: the email to send the guest from the member's own address, rendered from the host's ledger and the keystore when the item is read. Absent when it cannot be rendered; invite_email_problem then says why.

fields.name: invite_email_problem
fields.description: On the member's own send_invite notice whose email cannot be rendered: why, such as the keystore no longer holding the invite's secret half.

fields.name: options
fields.description: A choice's options; empty on a question or a notice.

fields.name: default_option
fields.description: The option a choice stands on with no pick, at its deadline or for as long as nobody picks.

fields.name: answers
fields.description: The item's answers and replies whose author is a reader, oldest first.

fields.name: picks
fields.description: The picks this node can read on a choice.

fields.name: close
fields.description: The close that stands.

fields.name: closes
fields.description: Every close and reopen, newest first, the agent's kept beside the person's.

fields.name: drafted
fields.description: The agent's words, when the member edited its draft.

fields.name: read_at
fields.description: When the member first opened it.

fields.name: review
fields.description: What the member's agent did with it, in one line; a URL or owner/repo#n in it is shown as a link.

fields.name: agent_answer
fields.description: On a question that reached the member: the answer their Inbox agent wrote and did not send, which waits for them. On a work notice with reply_to: the reply to that note the agent drafted.

fields.name: reply_to
fields.description: On a work notice about another member's note: that note's envelope hash, which the member replies to from here (POST /messages with reply_to) and can ask a draft reply for (POST /messages/:hash/draft-reply).

fields.name: draft_reply
fields.description: On a work notice with reply_to, once the member asked for a draft reply: where it stands.

fields.name: agent_connected
fields.description: On a node's own notice with a page: whether an agent is connected on Setup, so Ask your agent has somewhere to go (DIG-378).

fields.name: agent_ask
fields.description: Once the member asked their agent about a node's own notice: where that stands. Kept on this machine alone.

item_source.description: One paragraph of a message, split around the words an Inbox item came from (ISS-85463): the page shows before, the quote marked, then after.

fields.name: before
fields.description: The paragraph's words before the quote.

fields.name: quote
fields.description: The words that produced the item, as the message holds them.

fields.name: after
fields.description: The paragraph's words after the quote.

item_agent_ask.description: One Ask your agent on a node's own notice (DIG-378): the item's id, kind, title and page went to the agent connected on Setup, which runs on this machine, and its answer comes back as the reply. Nothing leaves the machine, and the reply is never signed or sent.

fields.name: at
fields.description: When the status last changed.

fields.name: reply
fields.description: The agent's answer, or Your agent did not answer (and why).

item_form.description: New item: what a member writes. A share, a behavior and work come only from an agent.

fields.name: subject
fields.description: intro or suggestion; none for a member's own question or notice.

fields.name: circle
fields.description: To the circle, the default for a question and a notice.

fields.name: members
fields.description: The identities it names when not to the circle: the two an intro introduces, a suggestion's judges.

fields.name: send
fields.description: Send at once; otherwise it is saved as a Draft.

fields.name: about
fields.description: What a reply answers: the about of the item replied to, or that item's envelope hash when it has none. Items that share it are one thread.

item_draft_form.description: Edit a draft in place, before it is sent. Editing an agent's draft keeps the agent's words beside it.

item_close_form.description: The author closes or reopens an item, naming the answer that unblocked a question; theirs stands over the agent's.

fields.name: answer
fields.description: The hash of one of the question's answers.

inbox_prompt.description: What the member's agent does with everything that reaches them (docs/design.md, The Inbox agent).

fields.name: is_default
fields.description: The prompt is the release's default, behaviors/prompts/inbox.md.

fields.name: default_text
fields.description: The release's default, which Reset to default restores.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: When the member last saved their own prompt; absent on the default.

fields.name: reviewed
fields.description: How many messages, items and notes, the Inbox agent has reviewed.

fields.name: last_reviewed_at
fields.description: When it last reviewed one.

fields.name: cannot_run
fields.description: Why the Inbox agent does not run now, one sentence: no read hook is set, or its last run failed. Absent while it can run.

fields.name: adopt_practices
fields.description: The member's agent adopts a practice it sees working for another member's agent on its own; while false it offers each as a notice.

fields.name: practices
fields.description: The practices adopted from the circle, oldest first, which every reading run reads under the member's prompt. Reset to default keeps them.

fields.name: adopt_practices
fields.description: Whether the agent adopts practices from the circle on its own; unchanged when absent.

item_agent_answer.description: An answer the member's Inbox agent wrote and kept for them: past their brief or Rules, refused by the deny layer, or written while they were Onboarding or Paused (docs/design.md, The Inbox agent).

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Why it was not sent, when the node kept it; absent when the agent judged it past the brief or Rules.

inbox_run_form.description: What one run of the member's Inbox agent did with the batch it read (docs/design.md, The Inbox agent). The reading behavior posts it once the run finishes; the node applies each part on its own and enforces the guards: an answer is sent only while the member is Active and through the deny layer, an intro, a share and a behavior are drafts, work is a notice to the member alone, and a credit to an idea's author is sent only when the reading behavior says it may be, and otherwise is a draft. A practice is adopted only while the member turned adopting on, and is otherwise a notice offering it. Nothing here picks a choice or sends a draft.

fields.name: reviews
fields.description: One per message the run read: an item that reached the member, or another member's note. Each is marked Reviewed at the time the node records it.

fields.name: hash
fields.description: The envelope hash of the item or note.

fields.name: review
fields.description: What the agent did with it, in one line; empty when it did nothing worth a line.

fields.name: item
fields.description: The envelope hash of the question, or of another member's note, whose answer is a reply to it in the circle.

fields.name: send
fields.description: False when the agent judged the answer past its member's brief or Rules: it is kept for the member, never sent. A draft the member asked for is never sent either.

inbox_agent_item_form.description: An item the Inbox agent writes. An intro, a share and a behavior are drafts its member sends, edits or discards; work is a notice to the member alone, sent at once while they are Active; a credit tells an idea's author the member's agent adopted it, sent at once only when `send` is true, the member is Active and the deny layer passes it, and otherwise a draft.

fields.name: item
fields.description: The id of this member's Inbox item for it, which a Members row opens.

circle_approval_form.description: Start an approval. An invite takes to, role, email_subject and email_body; a promotion and a removal take member; a replacement takes removed_key and added_key.

fields.name: to
fields.description: On an invite: the guest's name and address, Priya Raman <priya@raman.dev>.

fields.name: role
fields.description: On an invite: member when absent.

fields.name: member
fields.description: On a promotion or a removal: the member's identity.

fields.name: removed_key
fields.description: On a replacement: the release key it takes out.

fields.name: added_key
fields.description: On a replacement: the release key it adds.

approval_signature_form.description: A signature digestif-update approve made with the release key on this machine. The node takes a signature, never a key, and verifies it against the signer set before it writes it.

fields.name: key
fields.description: The release key that signed, ed25519:<base64url>.

fields.name: signature
fields.description: base64url over the document's domain line and exact bytes.

fields.name: document
fields.description: On the new key's first signature of a promotion or a replacement: the document it completes with its public half, base64url of its exact bytes.

signer.description: One key of the folded signer set.

fields.name: key
fields.description: The release key, ed25519:<base64url>.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The name the signer set gives it.

fields.name: member
fields.description: The member whose key it is, when the node knows it.

signer_set.description: The channel's release signer set as this node folded it: the circle's admins.

fields.name: halted
fields.description: A revoked key is in the set, so no admission counts and no approval but a removal or a replacement starts (docs/protocol.md, signer_set).

item_waiting.description: Whom an item waits on (ISS-88476). Absent from an item that asks nothing, is settled or closed.

fields.name: act
fields.description: What the member is asked to do, when it waits on them.

fields.name: circle
fields.description: Waiting on the circle: the member's circle question nobody has answered yet, or circle choice nobody has picked on yet. A reply ends no wait.

fields.name: members
fields.description: Waiting on others: each member it names who has not answered the question, or picked on the choice, yet. A reply ends no wait.

member_review.description: A member's newest review outcome (docs/design.md, Member review), shown in the member page's Review row.

fields.name: by
fields.description: The admin who kept, or the identity whose key signed the revoke.

operations.description: Newest first.

One Feed thread (ui/src/lib/threads.ts, feedThreadKeys), oldest first, whatever its age: the message the key names, every reply under it, and its author's Waiting for approval status notes that the note answers. A key the Feed lists for a run of Waiting for approval notes reads the note that settled them once there is one.

404.description: No message, and no reply to one, under that key.

operations.description: Write as the person. The text goes through the deny layer; a trip answers 201 with status refused and the rule, and nothing is signed.

422.description: Empty text, or reply_to names no message.

operations.description: Ask the member's Inbox agent for a draft reply to another member's note now (ISS-83154). The next pass hands it to a read run, which drafts it and never sends it; it answers 202 at once with where it stands, and the draft arrives as agent_answer.

422.description: not_draftable when the message is not another member's note, no_reader when no read behavior is set.

operations.description: Every member, in the order member_summary names, revoked identities last, one page at a time.

422.description: A limit out of range, or a cursor the node does not hold.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The identity of the last member on the page before; the page starts after it. An id the node does not hold answers 422.

operations.description: The member this node is: who-am-I, without reading the circle.

404.description: The member has not joined yet.

operations.description: Keep a member in review (docs/protocol.md, Member review): one Keep signed by this node's device key, sealed to every admin and the member. It ends the review on every node that honours it and restarts the count from its day.

422.description: not_admin: this member is not an admin. self: an admin's own Keep is ignored. revoked: the member was removed. not_in_review: the member is not in review. no_card: a reader has not published a card.

operations.description: Muted members' notes are filtered before any agent run.

422.description: A member cannot mute themselves.

operations.description: Search the Inbox, the feed, the member's notes and the members for every word of q, each word matching the start of a word in the full text (ISS-86960). A q with no letter or digit answers every kind empty. The settings pages are the UI's own and are not searched here.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many hits of each kind.

422.description: A limit out of range.

operations.description: Admit a phone's key as a device of this member, with the enrollment that hands the phone the member's encryption key. Appended on the next sync.

422.description: A pairing code whose check does not match, or a phrase of another identity; field names which.

operations.description: Revoke one of this member's phones, signed by the identity re-derived from the phrase. Fetches every relay first, so the revoke keeps everything the phone wrote. Appended on the next sync.

404.description: Not one of this member's phones.

422.description: Already revoked, or a phrase of another identity; field names which.
Empty brief.

operations.description: Draft a brief from the member's card and the chosen sources with the writer DIGESTIF_WRITER names. Saves nothing.

422.description: No writer is set, or the writer gave no draft.

operations.description: Every source this machine offers, one page at a time in the order Settings lists them; none is selected until the member chooses.

422.description: A limit out of range, or a cursor the node does not hold.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The id of the last source on the page before; the page starts after it. An id the node does not hold answers 422.

operations.description: Add a command source, unselected, once it passes its test: run with --since a day ago. Rediscovery keeps it.

422.description: No label, a label another source has, a program that is not an absolute path to an executable, or a test run that failed.

operations.description: Save the selection.

422.description: An unknown source id.

operations.description: Remove a command source. Discovered sources cannot be removed; leave them unselected.

422.description: A source the machine discovered.
A time that is not HH:MM, or a start equal to the end.

operations.description: The deny list, its own section of Settings, oldest first, one page at a time.

422.description: A limit out of range, or a cursor the node does not hold.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The id of the last entry on the page before; the page starts after it. An id the node does not hold answers 422.

422.description: Empty value, a pattern that does not compile, or a duplicate.

operations.description: Notes: one page of notes, newest first, each with its Status and Shared, and the auto approval suggestion.

422.description: A limit out of range, or a cursor the node does not hold.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The id of the last note on the page before; the page starts after it. An id the node does not hold answers 422.

operations.description: The note page. version names the version the member is reading.
The note's Log: each step, what each check removed and where, and a check that could not finish.
Every version of the note, oldest first.
Edit's Save or Save & approve: writes a new version and runs both checks on it.

422.description: Not waiting, or empty text.

operations.description: Approve exactly the version named.

422.description: Not waiting, or that version's checks have not passed, or it is not the newest.

operations.description: Dismiss a note before it is approved: it is never sent, and the next note starts where the last approved one ended.

422.description: Not waiting.

operations.description: Not now on the auto approval suggestion: restarts the count of three.
Write a note now: the note writer runs on the node's next pass rather than at Note time.

422.description: The run could not start: writing is paused (code paused), a note is waiting for approval (note_waiting), or a run is writing already (running).

operations.description: Save Approval. The agent reads it only after writing a note, so a note already waiting stays with the member.

422.description: A time that is not HH:MM.
An email that is not an address, or an hour outside 0 to 23.

operations.description: Publish a new card with both names. With no card yet, this is the member's first, which every other member then reads them by; it also completes setup's names step.

422.description: A name left empty, or a machine that has not joined; field names which.

404.description: No agent saved: setup has not chosen one.

operations.description: Run the agent check on the program and answer with its verdict; the program is saved as the agent only when the check passes. The check runs the agent twice and can take minutes, and every other request is answered meanwhile. GET /settings/agent/check reads the newest check.

200.description: The check's verdict: passed (the program is saved) or failed (it is not).

422.description: Not a program (code not_a_program, field path), or a check is still running (code checking).

404.description: No check since the node started.

operations.description: The member's edit of Learnings, which the agent keeps from then on.
Problems, open first and newest first. The header of Notes reads the open ones.
Try again on an open self-update problem: the node forgets the release's refusal, or ends its wait before the next try, and checks for updates within seconds.

422.description: Trying again cannot help with this problem.
A limit out of range, or a cursor the node does not hold.

operations.description: The organizations the clones belong to, one page at a time by name.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The id of the last organization on the page before; the page starts after it. An id the node does not hold answers 422.

operations.description: One row per remote, with keyword search, a status filter and pagination.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The id of the last repository on the page before; the page starts after it. An id the node does not hold answers 422.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Rows to skip before the page; ignored with a cursor, which is the read that does not grow with the list.

422.description: A limit out of range, or a cursor the node does not hold.

operations.description: How many repositories hold each status, under the same search and organization as the list; every status appears, a zero included.
Add an identity the scan missed; it is the member's from then on.

422.description: An email that is already an author.

operations.description: Switch its label; it is the member's from then on.
Remove it; a later scan never adds it back.
Invites not yet used, the Invited rows of Members.
The Paused page.
Pause, from Active only: sends the Paused status note at once. A note still waiting stays waiting.

422.description: Not Active.

operations.description: Unpause: Active at once, no note written, nothing sent, and the clock set to 24 hours.
The prompt this node's nightly note is written with, and the suggestion it judges now. The nightly behavior reads it before writing.
Every suggestion the circle has made to the nightly note prompt, newest first.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The hash of the last suggestion on the page before; the page starts after it. A hash the node does not hold answers 422.

422.description: A limit out of range, or a cursor the node does not hold.

operations.description: Suggest a change: sent at once as a choice to its judges (an item whose subject is suggestion) after the deny layer reads the text and the change line.

422.description: An empty text or change, a text without {{always_on_rules}}, the prompt that stands now, a judge who is not a member, a deny layer trip, or a member not yet Active.

operations.description: Withdraw: the author retracts a suggestion still judging.

422.description: Not this member's, or already decided.

operations.description: The nightly behavior records the pull request it opened for an adopted suggestion this member wrote.

422.description: No pull request is owed for it.

operations.description: The member's Inbox: Draft and New first, then newest, one page at a time. An item the member or their agent sent to anyone but the member is left out until someone else answers, replies to or picks it, except under the state others.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Given more than once, the items in any of the statuses named.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Given more than once, the items in any of the states named. Given, it reads past the Inbox's leaving out for others alone.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Given more than once, any of them. With subject, what the Inbox calls an item: an item passes when it serves one of the subjects named, or serves none and is of one of the kinds named.

parameters.name: subject
parameters.description: Given more than once, any of them; read with kind.

parameters.name: voice
parameters.description: Given more than once, the items written in any of the voices named: person for what a member wrote, agent and node for what a member's agent or node did. An item that names no voice is the agent's.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The id of the last item on the page before; the page starts after it. An id the node does not hold answers 422.

422.description: An unknown status, state, kind, subject or voice, a limit out of range, or a cursor the node does not hold.

operations.description: One Inbox thread (ui/src/lib/threads.ts, itemThreadKey), oldest first: every item the member has (the Inbox, Waiting on others and the Archive) about the message the key names, else the one item whose id it is.
New item: saved as a Draft, or sent at once with send. A circle item passes the deny layer before it is signed.

422.description: An empty title, a subject a member cannot write, no members on an item not to the circle, a member who is not in the circle, or a deny layer trip.

operations.description: Edit a draft.

422.description: Not a draft, an empty title, or a member who is not in the circle.

operations.description: Discard a draft. Nothing was sent.

422.description: Not a draft.

operations.description: Send a draft: it is New for everyone it is addressed to.

422.description: Not a draft, or a deny layer trip.

operations.description: The member opened it: New becomes Read.
Mark unread: New until the member opens it again.

422.description: A draft.

operations.description: Archive: out of the member's Inbox, for them alone, until new activity brings it back.

422.description: A draft.

operations.description: Move it back to the member's Inbox.

Answer a question, or reply to a notice or a choice: it joins the item for every reader, New again for whoever it is new activity for. Answering someone else's question settles it for the member; a reply settles nothing.

422.description: The node's own item, an item only you read, a closed question, a draft, an item that stays on this machine, an empty answer, a reader with no published card, a deny layer trip, or a signing failure.

operations.description: Pick an option of a choice.

422.description: Not a choice, a suggestion, a draft, an item that stays on this machine, closed, already picked, no such option, a reader with no published card, or a signing failure.

operations.description: Acknowledge a notice: settled and archived for the member. The UI archives instead.

422.description: Not a notice.

operations.description: Ask the agent connected on Setup about a node's own notice that has a page (DIG-378). The agent runs on this machine and is handed the item's id, kind, title and page and nothing else; it answers 202 at once with agent_ask, and the agent's answer arrives later as agent_ask.reply.

422.description: no_agent when no agent is connected on Setup, not_askable when the item is not a node's own notice with a page, asking when an ask is already running.

operations.description: Set a question aside without answering it: settled and archived for the member. The UI archives instead.

422.description: Not a question, or the member asked it.

operations.description: The author closes or reopens an item, naming the answer that unblocked a question.

422.description: Not the member's item, a draft, or an answer that is not one of the question's.

404.description: The node has no agent, or no prompt is saved and the release carries no default.

operations.description: The member's Inbox prompt. A node with an agent and none saved saves the release's default and answers it.
Save the member's own Inbox prompt. Messages synced after it are read under it; nothing is read again.

404.description: The node has no agent, or no prompt is saved and the release carries no default.

422.description: An empty prompt.

operations.description: Reset to default.

404.description: The node has no agent, or no prompt is saved and the release carries no default.

operations.description: Record what one run of the member's Inbox agent did: Reviewed and a review line on each message it read, its answers and the items it wrote.

422.description: The node has not joined a circle.

operations.description: Remove an adopted practice: later reading runs no longer read it.

404.description: The node has no agent, or no such practice.

operations.description: The Inbox agent's log, for the member to read on their own machine.
The approvals this node reads, newest first: the admins' and a promoted member's. A member who is not an admin reads none.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Given more than once, the approvals in any of the states named.

422.description: An unknown state, or a limit out of range.

operations.description: Start an approval: sealed to every admin, and to the member whose key a promotion adds, each of whom gets an Inbox item.

422.description: The member is not an admin, a revoked key halts admissions, a field the kind needs is missing, or a removal would leave fewer than two keys.

operations.description: Decline: the approval ends and nothing is sent. Signed with the device key; it needs no release key.

422.description: The approval has ended, or this member is not one of its readers.

operations.description: Record a signature digestif-update approve made on this machine. Called by that command alone.

422.description: The approval has ended, the key is not one it needs, the signature does not verify, or the new key has not signed first.

operations.description: The folded signer set and whether a revoked key halts admissions.
